artwork: Approved Cursed Lands copper-and-gold dragon CL monogram
generation: Built-in image_gen background removal from the approved artwork, requested on 2026-10-19
transparency: Keep the background and open spaces transparent on the website, GitHub and native icons.
derivatives: Lanczos resizing and platform file conversion with the alpha channel preserved

packaging.windows: Use the Windows export preset with application/modify_resources enabled. When using a qualified custom engine, set custom_template/release to that engine and export the executable; exporting only the PCK does not replace the Explorer icon.
packaging.macos: The macOS preset embeds assets/branding/icon.icns in the application bundle.
packaging.android: Godot uses application/config/icon for the launcher and adaptive foreground when the Android preset has no override.
packaging.staging: Copy game/icon.png and game/assets/branding along with the project. Resolve the project icon from config/icon instead of hardcoding icon.svg.
packaging.web: Regenerate web icon sizes and the service-worker hashes after changing the approved master.
